events.name: Wayanad Landslide
events.description: Catastrophic landslide at Mundakkai-Chooralmala villages, Wayanad, Kerala. Triggered by 572mm rainfall in 24 hours. Deadliest landslide in Kerala's history.

events.name: Cyclone Dana
events.description: Very Severe Cyclonic Storm Dana made landfall near Bhitarkanika, Odisha. Wind speed 100-110 kmph. 5.84 lakh people evacuated across Odisha and Andhra Pradesh.

events.name: Joshimath Land Subsidence
events.description: Rapid land subsidence in Joshimath, Uttarakhand. ISRO satellite data recorded 5.4cm subsidence in 12 days. 868 houses cracked. NTPC Tapovan-Vishnugad hydropower tunnel construction linked as contributing factor.

events.name: Delhi Yamuna Floods
events.description: Yamuna river breached all-time high of 208.65m in Delhi, surpassing 1978 record of 207.49m. 27,000+ people evacuated. Heavy rains plus Haryana dam release blamed.

events.name: Manipur Ethnic Violence
events.description: Ethnic conflict between Meitei and Kuki-Zo communities triggered by Meitei ST status demand. 200+ deaths, 70,000+ displaced. 143-day internet shutdown. Army and CRPF deployed.

events.name: Tata Semiconductor Fab
events.description: Cabinet approved India's first advanced semiconductor fab. Tata Electronics + Powerchip: ₹91,000 crore plant at Dholera, Gujarat. CG Power + Renesas: ₹7,600 crore at Sanand, Gujarat. Under India Semiconductor Mission.

events.name: Chandrayaan-3 Moon Landing
events.description: India's Chandrayaan-3 Vikram lander soft-landed on the lunar south pole, making India the first nation to land near the lunar south pole and the fourth globally to achieve a soft Moon landing. Pragyan rover operated for 14 days before entering sleep mode.

events.name: Aditya-L1 Solar Mission
events.description: ISRO launched India's first solar observatory Aditya-L1 from Sriharikota. Spacecraft inserted into L1 Lagrange-point halo orbit on 6 Jan 2024. Carries 7 payloads including VELC coronagraph for continuous solar observation.

events.name: G20 New Delhi Summit
events.description: India hosted the G20 Leaders' Summit under its Presidency theme 'Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam'. Historic consensus New Delhi Declaration on Ukraine, global debt restructuring, AI governance and sustainable development. African Union admitted as permanent G20 member.

events.name: India-Canada Diplomatic Row
events.description: Canadian PM Trudeau alleged Indian government involvement in killing of Khalistani separatist Hardeep Singh Nijjar in British Columbia. India expelled Canadian diplomat, suspended visa services, and rejected allegations. Bilateral relations severely strained through 2024.

events.name: IMEC Corridor Signing
events.description: India, USA, UAE, Saudi Arabia, EU, France, Germany and Italy signed MoU for India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC) at G20 sidelines. Rail-and-shipping route connecting India to Europe via Gulf, positioning India as a key global trade hub.

events.name: Chamoli Glacier Burst
events.description: A rock-ice avalanche from Nanda Devi massif, Chamoli, Uttarakhand triggered catastrophic flash floods in Rishiganga and Dhauliganga rivers. 204 persons dead or missing. Severely damaged NTPC Tapovan-Vishnugad and NHPC Rishiganga hydropower project tunnels.

events.name: Balakot Airstrikes
events.description: IAF Mirage-2000 jets struck Jaish-e-Mohammed camp in Balakot, KPK, Pakistan — India's first cross-border air strike since 1971. Conducted 12 days after Pulwama suicide attack killing 40 CRPF personnel. Pakistan retaliated; Wing Commander Abhinandan Varthaman was captured and released.

events.name: COVID Second Wave
events.description: India's devastating COVID-19 second wave driven by Delta variant peaked May 6 with 414,000 daily cases and 3,500+ daily deaths. Acute oxygen and hospital shortage. PM CARES fund deployed. Mass vaccination (18+) launched May 1, 2021. Total wave deaths estimated 1.6–3.2 million.

events.name: Russia–Ukraine War
events.description: Russia launched full-scale invasion of Ukraine on Feb 24 2022. 12,000+ civilians verified killed by OHCHR (Jan 2026); 6.7 million external refugees (UNHCR). India maintained strategic autonomy — abstained on UN votes, purchased discounted Russian crude oil (share rose from 2% to 40% of imports), and expanded bilateral trade to $65 billion in 2023-24. India's fertilizer imports from Russia account for 18% of urea and DAP supply.

events.name: Gaza War & Red Sea Crisis
events.description: Hamas attack on Israel (Oct 7 2023) triggered Israeli military campaign in Gaza. OHCHR verified 15,170+ civilian deaths as of Jan 2026; 1.7 million displaced (OCHA). Houthi militia in Yemen launched Red Sea shipping attacks from Nov 2023 — 80-90% of India–Europe cargo rerouted via Cape of Good Hope. Drewry freight index spiked 173%. India's gem, pharma and textile exports faced 10-15 day delays. IMEC corridor implementation frozen.

events.name: Article 370 Abrogation
events.description: Parliament passed resolutions abrogating Article 370 and 35A, revoking Jammu & Kashmir's special autonomous status. J&K bifurcated into two Union Territories — J&K (with legislature) and Ladakh (without). Internet blackout imposed for months. Supreme Court upheld validity in Dec 2023.

edges.reason: Both climate disasters in 2024 — same NDMA response framework, same NDRF fund
Both triggered EWS reform debate — lack of early warning systems
Both involve NTPC/Haryana infrastructure decisions affecting downstream populations
Both in 2023 triggered Parliament no-confidence and Centre-State blame — same political season
Manipur instability highlighted NE connectivity gap; semiconductor investment shifts strategic focus to western India
Both involve NTPC/infrastructure vs environment tradeoff — Joshimath dam vs semiconductor water usage policy
Back-to-back ISRO missions in 2023 — same launch infrastructure, budget cycle, and DOS mission strategy
IMEC MoU signed at G20 sidelines — same summit, same diplomatic momentum
Trudeau raised Nijjar allegations on G20 sidelines, straining India-Canada at India's diplomatic high point
Both Uttarakhand disasters — Chamoli triggered review of Tapovan-Vishnugad tunnel that overlaps Joshimath subsidence zone
Both 2019 — Balakot military action followed by Article 370 abrogation, representing dual-track assertive J&K policy
Both 2021 crises — COVID second wave coincided with Chamoli disaster, severely strained NDRF/NDMA response capacity
Both reflect India's deep-tech ambition — space and semiconductor programs share DOS/MeitY budget advocacy and PM Modi's vision
Both involve MHA-led security interventions in conflict-affected states with AFSPA and military deployment
Ukraine war accelerated European energy diversification that made IMEC strategically urgent; Russia-Ukraine stalemate shaped G20 declaration language at IMEC signing
Ukraine war exposed semiconductor supply chain vulnerability via Russia's neon gas (used in chip lithography) supply — accelerated India's self-sufficiency push
Houthi Red Sea attacks directly paralysed the sea leg of IMEC; the corridor signed Sep 2023 was frozen before implementation began
Both conflicts — India abstained on UN Security Council votes for both; same strategic autonomy doctrine, same Western pressure on India
India's G20 Declaration on Middle East peace was directly tested by Gaza war two weeks after the summit — undermining India's diplomatic credibility as broker
